title: Riparian buffer management for water quality and erosion control
claim: Vegetated riparian buffers intercept sediment and nutrient runoff from adjacent land before it reaches waterways, reducing erosion and protecting downstream aquatic habitat.
evidence_text: FAO land and water management guidance documents that vegetated riparian buffers — strips of native vegetation maintained along waterways — trap sediment and filter nutrients carried by surface runoff, particularly important where upstream land is degraded or under high rainfall. Deep-rooted native buffer vegetation also stabilises banks against erosion, reducing sediment loading that would otherwise smother downstream aquatic habitat.
